justification: Live screens showed typed planning rules: ADG separation fallbacks and an invented page number, a share image declaring CDC available from a typed 450 m2, and typed setbacks, lot sizes, floor areas and council values in tool pages, FAQs, the AI formatter and the granny flat PDF.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: parseADGSeparationText
functions.input: ADG 3F-1 requirement text read from sepp_adg_requirements
functions.output: parsed rows, or an empty list when the text cannot be parsed
functions.if_none: empty rows; the card says the table could not be read

functions.name: assess (OG image)
functions.input: property record, lot area, frontage, depth from the lookup
functions.output: facts plus a blocker only for zone or heritage; never a pass verdict
functions.if_none: neutral label: Check what applies to this lot

break_it.scenario: ADG text in the DB stops matching the parser
break_it.what_happens: card used to show typed distances as if read from the guide
break_it.repro: set requirement_text to an unparseable string
break_it.how: route returns no rows and the card shows a could-not-read message

break_it.scenario: a 300 m2 lot is shared on social media
break_it.what_happens: image could say CDC Pathway Available from a typed rule
break_it.how: pass verdict removed; label is neutral unless zone or heritage blocks

break_it.scenario: a rewrite leaves an unescaped apostrophe
break_it.what_happens: TypeScript build fails and the page 404s
break_it.how: 7 apostrophes escaped in verify-lgas.ts; tsc shows no syntax errors in touched files

post_merge.manual_verify: open /assessment ADG card and /granny-flat; fetch /api/og/granny-flat for one address

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a reachable user-facing string carries a typed rule value that is not listed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main before: 283 open with style values unlisted; after: 169
